text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... That was long... It 
was so long...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Kyoto's 3200m felt long, too... But 
getting here took way, way longer than 
that!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I... I finally ran in it. That Tenno Sho 
(Spring)...!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Are ya watchin', Pops?!! Your daughter 
just carved her hoofprints right here--!!
(UOOOOOOOH!!)

The grandstands resonated with Tamamo 
Cross's feelings. —And one Umamusume 
watched over that scene.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What is this... incredible...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even at a high-end fashion house's show, 
the crowd wouldn't get this wild. And 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Is this... the Senior Class GⅠ of the 
Twinkle Series... No, that's not it...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: This is... Tamamo-senpai's...

Tamamo Cross was creating a groundswell. 
An unknown wave—one that no one had ever 
witnessed before.
And the next day—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whew, finally quieted down. Trainer, 
wasn't I lookin' pretty majestic out 
there!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, told ya so. I showed 'em on that 
grand stage. The "White Lightning" you and 
I polished together!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
“Still, we're just gettin' started. Can't 
say I've fulfilled my wish till I conquer 
the Twinkle Series.”

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna do it! So that Dad, Mom, and 
the little ones never have to cry again!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Takarazuka Kinen! I'll wrap up 
this spring in style and head into the big 
autumn showdown—!
(Prrrr, prrrr...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's going on? Wonder who that is...

The smartphone buzzed with a vibration, 
and Tamamo Cross answered the call.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Is that you, Ma? What's up? We talked a 
whole bunch yesterday, so why call at this 
hour?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Is your work alright? Did something 
happen?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No way, this can't be real... She was so 
full of energy yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No way...... You've gotta... be kidding 
me......

Her gaze wouldn't move. Tamamo Cross just 
stood there, completely dazed.
